notes.title: Intrepid v1.0.2 (fixed Windows scaling issue)
notes.content:
Hello!

We've just released Intrepid v1.0.2. Changes include:

* arrow keys can now be used for navigation (for non-QWERTY keyboard users)
* keyboard input is now accepted for power panel lock and planet database
* numpad Enter now works :)
* settings are kept in user's home directory, not in Steam folder
* the game ignores Windows' application size settings

The last fix is especially important, since many users couldn't even start the game because of that issue (with Size of text, apps, and other items set to 150% the buttons in the main menu were not visible). Now the problem should be resolved and Intrepid will use the whole screen, ignoring Windows' scaling settings.

Due to a change in Intrepid settings file location, any existing settings will be discarded. Please keep in mind that the first time you run the game after this update, you will start with default values. Any new changes will be properly saved.

Now we are going to focus on enabling custom key bindings and making the pixel hunting less annoying (some gamers suggested highlighting interactive objects when they are in range). We're also working on a MacOS version, but there are still some issues to be resolved.

Thank you again for your feedback, it help us make Intrepid better!

Cheers,
Miskatonic Studio

notes.title: Intrepid 1.0.1 released!
notes.content:
Welcome in the new year!

We've just released the first update for Intrepid. It should fix the most urgent issues which have been reported by many people who played our game.

The list of fixes:
* moved the interaction prompt from the top right corner to the center of the screen
* reduced the default mouse sensitivity value
* fixed a bug where mouse sensitivity setting was reset when the game started
* settings are now saved (they are no longer reset every time the program starts)
* changed planet codes to 7 digits to avoid confusion with other codes in the game
* a different set of codes was simplified to make it more obvious how to use them (we're not going to tell which codes we mean, you will notice for sure ;) )
* security system buttons are no longer frustratingly hard to find

There are still some issues left with the game, but these seemed to be the most frustrating ones for most players. We will do our best to fix them all, but that will take more time. For now, we hope this update will make your experience with Intrepid much more pleasant.

If you notice any problems with the update or find any other issues, please let us know (either in a Steam comment or in our Discord channel).

Cheers,
Miskatonic Studio
